name: BC Invoice Forge - project ruleset
description: The app is a per-tenant extension (ID range 75000..78999), not an AppSource app. AppSourceCop runs to catch breaking changes and code issues; the rules below only make sense for AppSource submissions.

rules.justification: Per-tenant extension ID range; AppSource ID range validation does not apply.
AppSource listing properties (privacy statement, EULA, help, logo) are not required for a per-tenant extension.
AppSource listing URL is not required for a per-tenant extension.
No Application Insights resource is configured for this open-source app; telemetry is up to the installing tenant.
The app does not use namespaces yet; moving every object into namespaces is a separate change.
